acceptance: After merge, finalization confirms the named PR is MERGED with mergedAt and a non-null merge commit, and verifies that exact commit is reachable from freshly fetched origin/release before creating or pushing the tag.
An interruption after merge, local tag creation, or tag push can be resumed safely; matching tags are idempotent and mismatched local or remote tags fail closed without mutation.
A concurrent advance of release cannot cause vX.Y.Z to point to a different PR's commit; finalization works from a linked worktree without checking out the local release branch.

Focused tests exercise open/merged PR states, pending and failed required contexts, merge-result races, tag conflicts, and each interrupted state; the release guide names recovery commands and separate publication verification.

description: Close the gap between a successful squash merge and a pushed release tag. Prior art: release-finalize already checks the two required PR contexts before merge (Makefile:1248-1271); release.yml verifies tag ancestry and package version before build/publish (.github/workflows/release.yml:22-57). Extend that target rather than adding a second publisher. A fresh finalize must verify required contexts on the exact open PR head before merging. A resumed finalize may accept a confirmed MERGED PR, obtain its non-null merge commit, fetch origin/release and tags, and verify that the commit is on release. Create vX.Y.Z at that exact merge commit; if a local or remote tag exists, accept only an exact match and otherwise fail without moving it. Push the explicit tag ref without checking out a shared local release branch. Decision points: PR still open vs merged; tag absent vs exact match vs mismatch; tag pushed but release.yml pending/failed. Document each resume path in the runbook. Do not force-push, retag, replace a PyPI version, bypass required checks, treat queued/mergeable as merged, or infer publication from a pushed tag.
